Since \(\triangle ADE\) and \(\triangle ADC\) share altitude from \(D\) to \(AC\),

\[
\frac{S_{\triangle ADE}}{S_{\triangle ADC}}=\frac{AE}{AC}=k.
\]

Thus

\[
\frac{1}{4}=k.
\]

Because \(DE\parallel BC\), \(\triangle ADE\sim\triangle ABC\), so

\[
\frac{S_{\triangle ADE}}{S_{\triangle ABC}}=k^2=\frac{1}{16}.
\]

Hence

\[
S_{\triangle ABC}=16.
\]

Finally, \(S_{\triangle DBC}=S_{\triangle ABC}-S_{\triangle ADC}=16-4=12\).

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
